lib/frames/shotPrompt.ts:111 Recipes name one in-world source and what stays dark, written as described effects with no equipment terms (comment at 106-109 cites the what-stays-dark dojo); peak:ECU and reset:EWS do the same.

lib/frames/shotPrompt.ts:204 This context writes text-to-image prompts for plates; a move is passed through only when a person writes one, and the clip itself is directed in the motion step, outside this context.

pairs.registryProposal: lens-effect-language lists 'sharp-everywhere default (no depth-of-field clause)' as a failure, but the golden path says to leave dials that do not matter for the beat at neutral. The standard should say whether an unstated depth of field counts as neutral or as the failure.
